title: WikiFake
description: A Wikipedia article, a handful of facts rewritten by a model, and you. Find them alone or against other players — a free game of critical reading and fact-checking.

pick.title: Pick a subject
pick.detail: Any Wikipedia subject. The article is fetched as it stands today.

read.title: Read it against a model
read.detail: A model rewrites a few facts. Nothing marks them, and the rest of the article is untouched.

mark.title: Mark what is wrong
mark.detail: Every paragraph you flag is scored: right ones pay, wrong ones cost, and the clock pays too.

licence: Articles come from Wikipedia and are used under CC BY-SA. In a round they are deliberately modified, and are not encyclopaedic content.
